title: Controlled Medicine Agreement
about: An agreement between a patient and clinician about a controlled medicine (an opioid, a sedative or a stimulant): how it is taken, kept and refilled, and what the clinic will do.

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: This medicine can help. It can also cause harm, such as addiction or an overdose. This agreement helps us use it safely together.

blocks.label: I agree to
items: Take this medicine only as my clinician tells me.
Get this medicine only from my clinician here, and tell them if another clinician gives me any.
Use only the pharmacy above, unless we agree to change it.
Keep my medicine locked up and away from children and others.
Never share, sell or trade my medicine.
Tell my clinician about all the other medicines I take, and about alcohol or drug use.
Not drive or use machines if the medicine makes me sleepy.
Come to my visits, and give a urine or other test when asked.

blocks.text: If my medicine is lost or stolen, it may not be replaced early. The clinic may check records of my prescriptions from other places.

blocks.label: My clinic agrees to
items: Work with me on a plan for my health, not only my medicine.
Talk with me before changing my dose.
Not stop my medicine all at once without a plan, unless it is not safe to go on.
Offer help if I have trouble with the medicine, including treatment for addiction.
Offer naloxone, a medicine that can reverse an overdose.

blocks.text: We will look at this agreement together at least once a year.
